macDescendantProof.limitation: A child can call setsid and outlive its tmux pane. After the pane exits, the observed session/PID identity cannot enumerate or prove absence of that reparented child; the pgrep nonce counter of the real-process cycles only sees processes that still carry the nonce in argv, so a descendant that discards it or receives it through another channel escapes the count. The tested adapter therefore retains CleanupPending and host capacity; no Mac CLI combination is certified.
